correctness.rationale: For n≥5 and any simple complex spectrum, Lagrange interpolation cancels moments through degree 3, so the skew matrix N=u(Du)^T−(Du)u^T has N²=NDN=0. Orthogonal conjugation by I+tN gives the exact commutator direction for all t. A three-column Vandermonde factorization gives rank 3 and the degree-4 residue gives Q²=uu^T for n=5 and Q²=0 for n≥6, with Qu=0 in both cases. Nonzero off-diagonal entries and a triangle comparison rule out projective sign coincidences other than global reversal. Distinct eigenvalues imply smoothness of the two-quadric surface; its classical sixteen lines already exhaust the sixteen distinct barycentric images, and commutation by D is an invertible diagonal rescaling in Plücker coordinates. No classification of the whole isospectral cone is needed. The rational and modular evidence was inspected, not run, and is supplementary.
